Fresh and intense roguelike TPS with lots to see and lots to unlock. Does not feature permanent progression, except for the unlocking of characters, abilities and items. The unique infinite stacking of items and modifiers can lead to absolutely ridiculous runs, which become even more ridiculous with up to 3 friends in co-op. Also features a beautiful visual style and a very memorable soundtrack. The devs did an amazing job throughout Early Access and I can't wait to see what's next!
Fun game, especially with friends. It doesn't have the most content unless you buy DLCs. Overall a good roguelike for sure. Highly recommend for those interested in that genre.

This game is honestly phenomenal.

Countless hours with friends. Never an issue with performance (until runs get wayyyyy too long, RIP CPU), runs are always unique with items and artifacts to spice up each run, and numerous monsters with different variations of each type. Many "end-game" challenges to provide a sense of accomplishment even after the main character unlocks and different ability unlocks. Modding community is also a surprising and neat feature for this game. And don't get me started on the soundtrack.

Some issues can be monster spawn rates, item frequencies especially when playing multiplayer, and some other QOL changes such as maybe being able to drop items when in a multiplayer session could make this game even better, but mods could also solve this.

Easiest 10/10 for gameplay, replayability, fun with friends, and the soundtrack ("...con lentitud poderosa" is hands-down the best)

This game is nothing short of one, if not the best roguelike games I've ever played. The addition of the DLC has been very good in adding more content that changes up the gameplay enough to keep me entertained after already sinking in 200 hours into the game. The cast of characters to choose from varies significantly in terms of gameplay so its easy to change up the playstyle when one gets stale. Having unlockable items, abilities, and characters between runs keeps you playing to find more to spice up future gameplay. Coop is also extremely fun and balanced to have with friends as it scales with the number of players. The soundtrack is also filled with bangers, enough for me to never put music on in the background because its that good (Sky Meadows>>>). The devs are also very receptive of the community and it shows through the dev updates. Man, I even have ROR2 posters in my room, that's how much I enjoyed it.

Bungus 🍄

Survivors of the Void DLC: It makes some very welcome additions to the lists of items, characters, enemies and events. It definitely feels like it makes the game more complete with the void items and different game modes. I adore playing the Railgunner since she has a high skill ceiling (next to Mercenary probably), making playing her a great challenge. The Void Fiend is definitely not as satisfying to play but I can see why people may like them.

I have a lot more hours on Playstation, a very polished and consistently fun third person shooter roguelike. Playing with friends is also pretty nice.

The transition from 2D to 3D, from Risk of Rain 1 to Risk of Rain 2, is done very very well. The graphics are obviously different, but still feel akin to the first game. A lot of the items have returned, with small changes here and there to help accommodate the new 3D environment.

All the characters are fun (especially Acrid), and the ability variants you can get only add to the variety the game offers.

Fire elites still suck, but there's an item that can stop fire, so that's okay I guess.

this game is SO GOOD!! the gameplay is very intuitive and fluid once you learn what's up and its unique design makes every run feel so good. Even when you think you know pretty much all the mechanics there are, you learn even more that can be added to improve your gameplay. In addition to that, there are so many unlocks and new items and abilities to get, which are always very fun to grind for and play with. Even after having unlocked everything and done everything there is to do, i still and will find myself coming back again and again. i highly recommend this
